text:
The results of some tests on an aqueous solution of substance X are listed.
1
A cream precipitate is produced when adding aqueous silver nitrate.
2
Adding aqueous sodium hydroxide produces a green precipitate which dissolves in
excess alkali.
3
Adding aqueous ammonia produces a green precipitate which is insoluble in excess
ammonia.
What is substance X?
chromium(III) bromide
A
chromium(III) chloride
B
C
iron(II) bromide
iron(II) chloride
D
subject: Chemistry
